author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Xbox boss Asha Sharma sent an email to employees announcing a 'significant' restructuring of the company, citing losing "64 cents for every dollar invested" in their studios in an average year. Unfortunately 3,200 employees will be laid off, starting with 1,600 today and the rest to happen throughout Fiscal year 2027. Microsoft-owned studioss Double Fine and Compulsion Games will become independent studios, while others such as Ninja Theory and Undead Labs "have entered terms to join new ownership." Arkane Studios' management will enter into consultation with its workers council on next steps. No publicly-announced games are said to be cancelled as part of the reductions in workforce. In other news, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls has been blocked in 132 countries, likely due to Sony's PSN requirements, and PSN being blocked in specific territories. And finally, DC Studios' Supergirl has crossed $100 million at the global box office in its second week, and will like
title: Xbox Announces 'Significant' Restructure Starting With 3,200 Layoffs - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Check out the ‘In Rehearsal Tom Holland’ Featurette for The Odyssey, the latest mythological action retelling of Homer's tale from the mind of Christopher Nolan. Get a behind-the-scenes look at Tom Holland practicing fight choreography for the upcoming film. The Odyssey is in theaters on July 17.

Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand-new IMAX® film technology. The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to IMAX® film screens for the first time and opens in theaters everywhere on July 17, 2026. 

The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong’o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron.

The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.

#IGN #Movies
title: The Odyssey - Official Behind the Scene Clip (2026) Tom Holland

author: IGN
description:
Get another look at the psychological horrors that await you in The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu in this latest trailer for the co-op Lovecraftian adventure game. In The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, players take on the roles of explorers searching for legendary treasures deep within a hostile jungle. Before each expedition, players gather aboard the galleon to choose a contract and divide up weapons and equipment. Once they arrive on the continent, the explorers set out in search of treasures and resources to bring back to the galleon’s captain. A simple task in theory, but one that holds surprises.

The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on July 15, 2026.
title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - Official 'Ready Your Expedition' Trailer

author: IGN
description: Despite being in plenty of spin-offs and crossovers, Claire Redfield is in barely any of the mainline Resident Evil games. After a long time away, RE Veronica is finally set to give Claire her due. What do you think of the horror series' most ignored character? From Resident Evil 2, The Darkside Chronicles, Revelations 2, and more, Claire Redfield is one of Capcom's best characters and an icon within the Resi series. Are you looking forward to the remake of Resident Evil - Code: Veronica, and do you think Claire Redfield will return in a potential Resident Evil 10? Let us know!
title: Is Claire Redfield Underappreciated By Capcom?

author: IGN
description:
The high seas in Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced can feel alive when random open world events unfold right in front of your eyes unexpectedly. In this video, we were minding our own business when Pirates, Spaniards, and the British all converged near a small island and engaged in a battle across the three factions while we carefully looked in with patience. Once the battle began to subside, just like an pirate would, we swooped in to take out the victors and steal what they had aboard.

#IGN #Gaming
title: We Stumbled Upon a Wild Naval Conflict in Assassin's Creed: Black Flag Resynced
